documentation.value: --- Procedure per systemicTherapies[].history[] entry -------------------- Double-iteration: src.systemicTherapies[] → st.history[] → h

--------------------------------------------------------------------------- MapSystemicTherapy: DNPM systemicTherapies[].history[] entry → FHIR Procedure Profile: MII_PR_MTB_Systemische_Therapie (Parent: MII_PR_Onko_Systemische_Therapie) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
status: translate DNPM therapy status → FHIR Procedure.status

extension (mii-ex-mtb-leitlinie-dokumentation): therapyLine as sub-extension Extension URL: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-ex-mtb-leitlinie-dokumentation

medication[]: each ATC entry → a separate MedicationStatement resource linked via partOf back to this Procedure is the recommended pattern; however, since medication codings must end up in the Bundle, we create MedicationStatement entries inline via separate group (see below). The Procedure itself does not carry medication directly per the MII profile (MII_PR_Onko_Systemische_Therapie inherits from Procedure, not MedicationAdministration). We record the medication codes as supportingInfo-like annotations on the Procedure using the 'usedCode' element (0..*) which accepts CodeableConcept.
code: LOINC 21976-6 "Response to cancer treatment" — parent Onko Verlauf uses this
partOf ← therapy.id (MTBSystemicTherapy reference) Profile uses partOf (not focus) for the associated systemic therapy
Use the MII MTB response assessment CodeSystem for the MTB slice
valueCodeableConcept: DNPM RECIST value.code → MTB slice System: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-response-befund-beurteilung
method: assessment method (RECIST / RANO) — required by profile (1..1) DNPM passes the system name as the method indicator; map to the MII beurteilungsmethode CS
